# G. Sunil Kumar Reddy — Portfolio

This website presents the work and professional direction of G. Sunil Kumar Reddy, a Computer Science and Engineering student at NIST University.

## Professional focus
- Backend development and software engineering
- APIs, server-side application logic, databases, and practical software
- Supporting interests: Linux, networking, cybersecurity, and product thinking
- Seeking internships and entry-level software engineering opportunities

## Projects
- Self-Evolving API Rate Limiter: public repository documents a FastAPI service with token bucket and sliding-window controls, per-request telemetry, Z-score spike detection, a Q-learning limit adjustment loop, a dashboard, and traffic simulators. The README notes in-memory state and a warm-up requirement for adaptive behavior. This is an exploratory project; no production impact or performance claim is made.
- TraceMe: public repository describes a Python/Flask interface integrating Sherlock for username searches across public platforms. Search results are possible account matches, not confirmed identity. Holehe integration is documented as work in progress.
- Network Troubleshooting Inspector: project details and stack were supplied by the portfolio owner; repository verification is pending.
